scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n tablet,esp32 -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -F tablet dev" "pnpm -F mock-esp32 dev"
scripts.dev:all:lan: concurrently -n tablet,esp32 -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -F tablet dev:lan" "pnpm -F mock-esp32 dev"
scripts.dev:bridge: concurrently -n tablet,bridge -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -F tablet dev:lan" "pnpm -F mock-esp32 start -- --serial"
scripts.dev:ps5: concurrently -n tablet,ps5 -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -F tablet dev:lan" "pnpm -F mock-esp32 start -- --ps5"
scripts.prod:ps5: pnpm -F tablet build && concurrently -n tablet,ps5 -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -F tablet preview:lan" "pnpm -F mock-esp32 start -- --ps5"
